# ClashOwl

> ClashOwl is a daily US trademark-watch email alert for small brands. It uses USPTO data to flag new filings that look like your brand, so you can act during the opposition window.

ClashOwl is for small sellers, including Etsy, Amazon and Shopify shops, who want to know when someone files a US trademark close to their name.

- What it does: sends a daily email alert about new US trademark filings similar to your brand
- Who it's for: small brands and independent online sellers in the US
- Data source: USPTO trademark data
- Pricing: $15/mo or $149/yr (up to 3 brands), or $49/mo Portfolio (up to 15 brands)
- Website: https://clashowl.com

## Guides

- [Someone Filed a Trademark on My Shop Name: A US Seller's Guide](https://clashowl.com/guides/someone-filed-a-trademark-on-my-shop-name.html): what to check, prior-use evidence, the 30-day opposition window, TTAB opposition vs. cancellation, marketplace IP reports and scam messages
- [How to Check if a Shop Name Is Trademarked Before You Use It](https://clashowl.com/guides/how-to-check-if-a-shop-name-is-trademarked.html): searching the USPTO database, what counts as confusingly similar, why related goods matter, common-law use and state registries, and when to call an attorney
- [Got a Trademark Cease and Desist Letter as a Small Business? What to Do Next](https://clashowl.com/guides/got-a-trademark-cease-and-desist-letter.html): what the letter means and what a lawsuit looks like, checking the claim in TSDR, common-law rights and priority evidence, the USPTO's response options, and Etsy IP takedowns and withdrawals
- [Can I Trademark My Etsy Shop Name, and Is It Worth It?](https://clashowl.com/guides/can-i-trademark-my-etsy-shop-name.html): what the USPTO will and won't register, current federal filing and maintenance fees, how filing works, why Etsy trademark reports usually need a registration, Amazon Brand Registry requirements, and when registering is worth it
- [Letter of Protest or Opposition? How to Fight a Trademark Application at the USPTO](https://clashowl.com/guides/letter-of-protest-vs-trademark-opposition.html): checking publication status in the Official Gazette, what a letter of protest can and can't do, why common-law prior use belongs in a TTAB opposition, current USPTO fees, extension deadlines up to 180 days, and cancellation after registration
- [Does an LLC or DBA Protect My Business Name?](https://clashowl.com/guides/does-an-llc-protect-my-business-name.html): what an LLC entity name, a DBA and a domain do and don't protect according to the SBA, trade names vs. trademarks per the USPTO, geographic limits of common law rights, state vs. federal registration, and what to search before you form the LLC
- [Someone Is Copying My Brand Name on Amazon. What Can I Do?](https://clashowl.com/guides/someone-is-copying-my-brand-name-on-amazon.html): documenting the copycat listing, the USPTO's likelihood-of-confusion factors, registered vs. pending vs. common-law rights, Amazon Brand Registry requirements and reporting tools, why the USPTO doesn't enforce for you, court remedies and CBP recordation, and the $350-per-class base filing fee
